## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

Hen has a nest in the grass. The nest has six eggs. Hen sits on the eggs to keep them warm and safe. Duck lives in the pond by the farm.

</div>

Duck can swim and dive and splash. "Quack!" says Duck. "Come swim with me, Hen! The water is fun!"

"I cannot swim," says Hen.

Duck gets out of the pond. Duck waddles up the bank to the nest. "I will sit with you," says Duck. "The sun is hot.

## Think About It

1. Where does Hen sit? (On her nest with eggs.) 2. Where does Duck live? (In the pond.) 3. What hatches at the end? (A chick.)
